sources.title: Ministry of Home Affairs (moha.gov.gy), Central Immigration and Passport Office Launches New 10-Year Passport
sources.said: the Central Immigration and Passport Office under the Guyana Police Force, through the Government of Guyana, has rolled out the new Co-operative Republic of Guyana Ten-Years Passport, effective today, Monday, February 10, 2025. ... Applicants will now have the option to choose between a five-year or ten-year validity period. The cost for the five-year validity remains at G$6,000, while the cost for the ten-year validity is G$12,000 for an ordinary passport
